Step Final — GitHub Branch Management (MANDATORY):

1. Ensure clean working tree on feature/WF03-gh377-20260804:
   git status --short (should be empty)
   git branch --show-current (must output: feature/WF03-gh377-20260804)

2. Fetch latest main: git fetch origin main

3. Rebase onto main if any new commits appeared: git rebase origin/main. Resolve if conflicts (should be none for a fast-forward).

4. Push final feature branch state: git push origin feature/WF03-gh377-20260804

5. Create the PR:
   gh pr create --base main --head feature/WF03-gh377-20260804 \
     --title 'fix(WF03-gh377): ISS-0114 — tenant-schema routing (pool resolver + Step 6a INSERT + migration 1135)' \
     --body $'Resolves #377 (ISS-0114).

Three-layer fix:
1. src/db/pool.zig — resolveAndCacheStorageMode fallback to public.tenant_schemas when public.tenant returns 0 rows.
2. src/db/provisioning.zig — Step 6a authoritative INSERT INTO public.tenant with all 7 NOT NULL columns (fixes C23502 cascade).
3. migrations/1135_iss0114_backfill_public_tenant_storage_mode.sql — idempotent backfill.

Plus: src/db/migrations.zig SHOW search_path post-condition; tests/integration/helpers.zig tenant_context.clear() per-test reset.

Test outcome: net +35 integration test passes, 0 regressions, 0 occurrences of `null value in column slug` (was 97), 3 of 7 ISS-0114-affected TCs now PASS.

Follow-up issues filed:
- #417 ISS-0127 D1: pool.zig resolver LEGACY_RLS fallthrough on TC-TNT-03-01/03 (BLOCKER)
- #418 ISS-0128 D2: event_store/store.zig:337 StoreError.InstanceNotFound on TC-DB-03-01 (BLOCKER)
- #419 ISS-0129 D3: migration 1135 DROP TRIGGER C40P01 deadlock on TC-TNT-01-01 (MAJOR)'

6. Wait for CI to be green (gh pr checks --watch).

7. Merge PR:
   gh pr merge --squash --delete-branch

8. Verify cleanup:
   git fetch origin
   git branch -r | grep feature/WF03-gh377 (should be empty)

9. Return to main:
   git checkout main
   git pull --ff-only origin main
   git branch --show-current  →  must output: main
   git log --oneline -1  →  must show the squash-merge commit
   git status  →  must show clean working tree

10. Update handoff file with: status=COMPLETED, result.status=PASS, result.summary, result.artifacts_out (PR number, merge SHA), completed_at=<current UTC>.

Update handoffs/registry.json for this entry.
acceptance_criteria: PR created against main on feature/WF03-gh377-20260804
PR checks green (or documented as not required)
PR merged via gh pr merge --squash --delete-branch
Remote feature branch deleted (gh pr merge cleanup verified)
Local repo on main with clean working tree
git log -1 shows the squash-merge commit
Handoff result includes PR number and merge SHA
